name: Asmodee Group AB (publ)
summary: Asmodee Group AB (publ) engages in publishing and distribution of tabletop games. The company offers board games, trading card games, and various other type of games played on or around table. Its portfolio includes CATAN, Ticket to ride, Dobble/Spot-it!, 7 Wonders, and Exploding Kittens. The company also establishes third-party licensing and/or distribution collaborations with entertainment franchises and third-party IP owners. It operates in Sweden, France, Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, rest of the Americas, rest of Europe, and internationally. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.
